item.title: Mets make changes to MLB coaching staff; Jeff Albert among those who won't return
item.description: Three members of the Mets' coaching staff won't return to their roles in 2027 but the rest of the group is expected to be back next season.
item.media:description: The Mets' MLB coaching staff will not include Jeff Albert (pictured), Danny Barnes or Kevin Mahoney next season, though all three could find different roles in the organization.

item.title: Mets offseason payroll breakdown: Where does New York stand before transformative winter?
item.description: With the financial uncertainty in baseball top of mind, let's look at the Mets’ payroll heading into 2027 and beyond.
item.media:description: Why Bo Bichette isn't likely to opt-out this year and why that would be good news for the Mets.
